how.title: How to give
how.intro: Three steps, under a minute, from your phone.

s1.title: Choose the collection
s1.text: Each collection has its own ribbon colour and its own total.

s2.title: Enter your amount
s2.text: With your name or anonymously: it's up to you.

s3.title: Pay with Mobile Money
s3.text: Orange Money or MTN MoMo: a payment request arrives on your phone, you approve it, and your gift is added to the total.

impact.title: What your gifts made possible
impact.intro: Closed collections, from the total received to what was handed over. Any difference comes from an advance or a transfer between collections, which are recorded too.

footer.name: MLA, Impact Centre Chrétien Yaoundé
footer.contact: A question about a gift? Contact the MLA secretariat.
